listing.name: systemRescan v.20260110
listing.summary: Adds a sidebar plugin that passively rescans the current star system every 10 seconds or upon entering a new system.
listing.aiSummary: Adds a sidebar plugin that passively rescans the current star system every 10 seconds or upon entering a new system.

description:
systemRescan

download link:

https://www.mediafire.com/file/l11op589fkkdp10/systemRescan-20260110.zip/file

requires sidebarLib:

https://fractalsoftworks.com/forum/index.php?topic=31499.0

somewhat of a spiritual successor of the old "object analysis"

https://fractalsoftworks.com/forum/index.php?topic=20331.0

given that the original doesn't _quite_ work all that well and takes up an ability slot, i decided to just remake it from scratch as a sidebar plugin

that way it always stays on screen and doesn't require on-hover action

runs passively when enabled, rescans system every 10 seconds or when you enter new starsystem
